subject: Planned Development District Fee Schedule
overview: The committee met to review proposed application and consultant review fees for planned development districts. Discussion focused on setting an application fee in Appendix A of the city ordinances and establishing review accounts under state law.

items.title: Planned Development District Application and Consultant Fees
items.summary: The committee discussed a proposed application fee of five cents per square foot of construction above 5,000 square feet, and reviewed procedures under Chapter 44, Section 53G to assess outside consultant review costs to applicants.
